notes: Table title: 'Depth, in feet, of Tulare Lake in Kings County, Cal., for the year ending Sept. 30, 1916'. Depth of lake recorded as gage_height (page calls it stage); a lake, so Reservoir. Scattered readings; first printed value Oct. 4, last Sept. 2; water year of the title given as dates. Counted by month: Oct 3, Nov 4 (incl. .0 on the 21st), Dec 4, Jan 3, Feb 10, Mar 14, Apr 9, May 19, June 30, July 15, Aug 2, Sept 1 = 114. No station name of the form water body + relation + place, no coordinates. Text mentions the water's edge was 3 miles from the town of Corcoran in November 1907 (not used as the site's place). The Deer Creek at Hot Springs heading below the table belongs to another station.
